The sequence is a dependency graph rather than a rigid calendar. A diagnostic
may justify moving faster, but a course prerequisite means you should be able to
use its core ideas without continual review.

| Stage | Course | Why it appears here |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | [Advanced Algebra](../../courses/advanced-algebra/index.qmd) | Establishes symbolic and functional fluency used everywhere else. |
| 1 (parallel) | [Mathematical Computing](../../courses/mathematical-computing/index.qmd) | Builds reproducible tools used for verification and exploration. |
| 2 | [Discrete Mathematics](../../courses/discrete-mathematics/index.qmd) | Makes logic and proof practices explicit. |
| 2 | [Linear Algebra](../../courses/linear-algebra/index.qmd) | Introduces structural reasoning with vectors and transformations. |
| 3 | [Differential Calculus](../../courses/differential-calculus/index.qmd) | Develops local change through limits and derivatives. |
| 4 | [Integral Calculus](../../courses/integral-calculus/index.qmd) | Develops accumulation and the inverse relationship with differentiation. |
| 4 | [Probability](../../courses/probability/index.qmd) | Builds models of uncertainty from axioms and random variables. |
| 5 | [Statistics](../../courses/statistics/index.qmd) | Uses probability and computation to reason from data. |
| 5 | [Differential Equations](../../courses/differential-equations/index.qmd) | Synthesizes calculus, linear algebra, modeling, and numerical work. |
| Throughout | [Cumulative Review](../../courses/cumulative-review/index.qmd) | Protects earlier knowledge through interleaved retrieval. |

## Readiness rule

Before advancing, sample the course outcomes rather than relying only on lesson
completion. You are ready when you can choose methods, explain why they apply,
complete representative work without scaffolding, and interpret limitations.
